sources.title: otonose kanade (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It is composed of a [[white shirt]] worn under a [[plaid dress|plaid]] pattern [[double-breasted]] [[brown dress]] with a [[brown sailor collar]], [[red ribbon|red]] [[neck ribbon]], [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[frilled jacket|frilled]] [[white jacket]] with a [[white sailor collar|sailor collar]], single black [[thigh strap]] on her right leg, [[brown thighhighs]], and light [[brown footwear|brown]] [[shoes]] with [[red bow]]s.
